description: Turns a plain-English trade job into an itemized bid — real materials by size, fittings, consumables, labour on its own line, at realistic US market prices.

job_description.description: Plain-English description of the trade job, e.g. "Replaced the panel, 85 feet of conduit, 8 can lights, 16 hours."

trade.description: Trade for the estimate: electrical, plumbing, hvac or general.
